## Checklist (if adding a new route)

- [ ] Added entry to `routes.json` following the schema in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] `id` is unique and kebab-case
- [ ] 2–4 waypoints in driving order
- [ ] Rating uses the rubric (Pavement / Technicality / Scenery / Traffic / Bring-a-friend)
- [ ] `summary`, `best_time`, `watchouts` all filled in
- [ ] `google_maps_url` opens to a turn-by-turn route
- [ ] Tested locally (`python3 -m http.server 8765`) and confirmed the road traces correctly
- [ ] Photo (if added) is on Wikimedia Commons or your own work, with credit
